issues.title: Egypt approves military support for Saudi Arabia after Houthi attacks escalate
issues.title_en: Egypt approves military support for Saudi Arabia after Houthi attacks escalate
issues.summary: CAIRO, Oct 26 (Reuters) - Parliament authorised Egypt's military on Monday to provide support to help defend Saudi Arabia, parliamentarians said and local media reported, a move that could push Cairo directly into the regional conflict that has expanded with intensified attacks by Yemen's Iran-allied Houthis on the Gulf kingdom.
